import config_reader
import json

def test_basic_functionality():
    text = """endpoint = http://127.0.0.1:11434
enabled = true"""
    settings = config_reader.read_settings(text)
    assert 'endpoint' in settings
    assert 'enabled' in settings
    assert settings['endpoint'] == 'http://127.0.0.1:11434'
    assert settings['enabled'] is True

def test_boolean_conversion():
    text = """enabled = false"""
    settings = config_reader.read_settings(text)
    assert settings['enabled'] is False

def test_ignored_lines():
    text = """# comment
    
    endpoint = http://127.0.0.1:11434
    enabled = true
    """
    settings = config_reader.read_settings(text)
    assert 'endpoint' in settings
    assert 'enabled' in settings

def test_malformed_line():
    text = """endpoint = http://127.0.0.1:11434
    malformed_line
    enabled = true"""
    try:
        config_reader.read_settings(text)
        assert False, "Expected ValueError for malformed line"
    except ValueError:
        pass

def test_duplicate_key():
    text = """endpoint = http://127.0.0.1:11434
    endpoint = http://127.0.0.1:11435
    enabled = true"""
    try:
        config_reader.read_settings(text)
        assert False, "Expected ValueError for duplicate key"
    except ValueError:
        pass

def test_missing_required_keys():
    text = """endpoint = http://127.0.0.1:11434"""
    try:
        config_reader.read_settings(text)
        assert False, "Expected ValueError for missing 'enabled' key"
    except ValueError:
        pass

def test_invalid_boolean_value():
    text = """enabled = maybe"""
    try:
        config_reader.read_settings(text)
        assert False, "Expected ValueError for invalid boolean value"
    except ValueError:
        pass

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_basic_functionality()
    test_boolean_conversion()
    test_ignored_lines()
    test_malformed_line()
    test_duplicate_key()
    test_missing_required_keys()
    test_invalid_boolean_value()
    print("All tests passed!")
